messages.text:
**RECO-PhysVal-03 completed** at **`f9c5621800b714e738fe6e1b4b331c9143fb06b6`**. I found **no scientific correctness blocker** for delivering the isolated reconstruction prototype as a draft PR. Human acceptance remains pending.

I authored the earlier evaluation protocol, independently reviewed this implementation, and did not author its code, campaign reductions or figures. No files were changed, simulations rerun or dependencies modified.

**Independent checks completed**

- Reclassified **all40,000 processed validation entries** from the eight native JSONL files using separately written matching and quality logic. Every CKF/ambiguity count and retained representative agrees exactly.
- Checked unique inlier/source-link membership, purity/completeness, generated and conditional denominators, ordered raw/estimated seed sources, measured pixel coordinates, full CKF measurement membership and frozen measurement variances.
- Every pixel space point equals the native float32 cast of measured-local→global coordinates exactly.
- Replayed the retained verifier: **60 cases /66,000 processed generated entries PASS**, including artifacts, actual executed source revisions, runtime identities, baseline payload equivalence, residuals and pulls.
- Independently reproduced the complete13-profile ranking and selected `pt4-nominal-triplet`.
- Verified selection bytes were frozen at **780edf14**, and geometry/response/field/matching/reconstruction settings remained unchanged through the I/O repair. Final seed123042 was committed before validation launch at **0e3b921**.
- Independently reproduced headline efficiency intervals, central d0/z0 widths, momentum tails, wrong-charge counts, ≥10-inlier coverage and full pull-tail statistics.
- Inspected efficiency, integrated-pull and resolution-versus-η figures; their captions and finite display windows are consistent with the retained arrays.

| pT [GeV] | Selected primary matches /5,000 | Accepted unmatched | Wrong charge |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 4,859 | 1 | 0 |
| 5 | 4,964 | 1 | 0 |
| 10 | 4,965 | 2 | 0 |
| 100 | 4,972 | 0 | 95 |

All four unmatched candidates contain only primary measurements and fail the frozen completeness requirement: **8/19,7/15,8/18 and8/17**. The report correctly distinguishes these partial tracks from mixed-origin combinatorial fakes. No ambiguity-surviving duplicates or secondary matches were observed.

**Material limitations are reported accurately**

- At1GeV, q/p pull SD is **1.765737**, with **60/4,859** entries beyond5σ. These tails remain uncut.
- At100GeV, **95/4,972** matched tracks have wrong charge; all lie within **3.243≤|η|≤3.987**. The same95 wrong-charge tracks already occur in the control. There are **390** matched tracks with relative pT error above50%.
- High matching efficiency therefore does not establish uniformly good forward momentum or charge reconstruction.
- Zero fake events at100GeV supports the stated **0.0599% one-sided95% event-incidence upper limit**, not a zero fake-rate claim.
- Control/momentum samples are paired and repeated tuning cases are correlated; the report correctly avoids pooling them as independent trials.
- Time remains prior-dominated; ct[mm] arrays and ns public axes are consistent.
- Native propagation failures without completed output tracks remain diagnostics rather than exact fit-error counters.
- Detailed material mapping, response realism and high-occupancy performance remain outside this study.

The one wording issue was **“untouched native-default control”**: the initial adapter control already includes shared3T, minPt0.5GeV and ROI overrides. The coordinator accepted replacing this with **“initial nODD adapter control”** and stating those overrides. This is a documentation correction; no data or selection change is needed.

Spack source preflight still reports changed setup/lock fingerprints and unverified full DD4hep/Geant4 sources. This assessment used exact ACTS355ea source and existing completed evidence; it does not independently certify the external installation.

limitations: Only userMessage and agentMessage text retained; reasoning, tool arguments/results and private state excluded.
Conservative path, credential, email and URL redaction is not a privacy guarantee; review retained text.
Exposed operation counts are per retained turn; journal counts can describe the same invocations and must not be added.

Visible text was additionally sanitized in memory before curation; ephemeral output paths omitted. read_thread capped individual message text at10000characters; selection is not a complete private transcript.
